messages:
Mia R.: FYI procurement is rejecting a batch of POs coming from Skyline. Error looks like an invoice XML namespace mismatch. put the sample below.
Lucas W.: ugh, we saw a handful yesterday too. Wasn't sure if it was vendor-side or our parser update.
skyline-invoice-bot: [automated] 1955129876 - INVOICE_REJECTED - reason=XML_NAMESPACE_MISMATCH vendor_id=skyline-452 ref_po=PO-9987
Mia R.: here's the snippet from the rejection log + offending XML header:
```xml
<?xml version="1.0"?>
<Invoice xmlns="http://schemas.skyline.com/invoice/v2" id="inv-12345">
  <PORef>PO-9987</PORef>
  ...
</Invoice>
```
Procurement's expected namespace is `http://schemas.marketplace.com/invoice/v1` so our connector is treating it as unsupported format.
Jordan P.: is this happening only for Skyline or multiple marketplace partners? quick check would help prioritize.
Lucas W.: so far only Skyline reported. They recently upgraded to v2 of their invoice format. We never onboarded v2 to the PO routing parser.
Sanjay K.: ok, two routes: (1) ask Skyline to emit v1 namespace as compatibility OR (2) add v2 namespace to our parser mapping and add a unit test. I can scope the work. Which do we prefer? :thinking_face:
Evangelina (Marketplace): Marketplace ops: vendor-side change is usually slower (legal + billing). Can we do a soft-accept fallback for namespace variants in the connector? That would avoid unprocessable rejects for customers.
Jordan P.: procurement needs the POs processed today. Can we hotfix the parser to accept both namespaces and deploy a patch to the connector? If it's quick, do it.
Lucas W.: estimate ~2-3 dev-hours to add namespace aliasing + regression test. Need a QA deploy window though.
Mia R.: procurement will hold payouts until invoices attach to the POs. This is blocking onboarding for 3 new customers. Higher priority.
Sanjay K.: I'll open an internal ticket and ping eng-runtime. Jordan, can you raise the procurement escalation (email thread) and cc product? I'll own the engineering side.
Jordan P.: on it. drafting email now -> will include the automated log and the XML snippet. Also tagging Skyline rep.
Evangelina (Marketplace): cc @skyline-ops? We should ask them to confirm whether they can add a v1 namespace toggle on their side as a temporary fix.
Jordan P.: @skyline-ops (cc) — can you confirm if you can toggle namespace to `http://schemas.marketplace.com/invoice/v1` for these POs? If not, please share ETA to support v1 compatibility.
skyline-invoice-bot: [automated] skyline-ops acknowledged. comment: "looking into namespace toggle, ETA 24h" :white_check_mark:
Lucas W.: I'll start the connector patch now. Will post diff and QA steps here.
Sanjay K.: thx. If engineering pushes a parser update, ops: please route through staging and smoke test with a sample Skyline invoice (we can use inv-12345).
Mia R.: procurement: hold on payouts but mark as priority escalation. Jordan will send the formal note.
Jordan P.: sent. Subject: "Urgent: PO processing halted due to Skyline invoice namespace (PO-9987, PO-9991, PO-10002)". Procurement replied -> they will delay payments 24h pending a fix.
Lucas W.: patch posted: https://git.redwood/s/connector-xml/compare/namespace-aliasing. Diff includes mapping for `http://schemas.skyline.com/invoice/v2` -> treat as `marketplace/v1`. QA steps:
  - POST sample v2 invoice to /ingest with PO header
  - verify parsed.po_ref == "PO-9987"
  - verify invoice accepted into queue
Sanjay K.: deploying to staging now. ETA 30m. Will run the three sample invoices.
skyline-invoice-bot: [automated] skyline-ops update: cannot toggle on short notice. working on compatibility; ETA 24h remains.
Evangelina (Marketplace): good we have both paths. If staging looks good, let's schedule a hotfix deploy to prod in the next deploy window (30-60 min). Procurement agreed to 2-hour hold if we can get patch live.
Mia R.: please @here once prod deploy is live so I can notify procurement & customer success.
Lucas W.: staging tests passing. opening prod deploy PR now.
Sanjay K.: prod deploy completed. smoke-tested; three POs processed and linked. ✅
Mia R.: procurement notified, customers informed. thanks all. :tada:
Jordan P.: follow-up: we should add vendor onboarding checklist item for schema version compatibility + a monitoring alert for namespace mismatch rate > 1%/day.
Evangelina (Marketplace): agree. I’ll add onboarding checklist item and create a short runbook for vendors. Also scheduling a sync with Skyline for long-term compatibility.
Mia R.: closing thread — will reopen if procurement sees more rejects.
